name: procedure_references
description: Return incoming or outgoing reference edges for one procedure. Ghidra preserves detailed reference flags; Hopper preserves native CallReference classifications and exact endpoints. Select detail summary to retain complete Evidence and page references or unresolved calls using inspect_analysis_view kind native-procedure-references. Page coverage describes retained observations, not complete discovery or proof the target ran.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.
